mapper.select: SELECT matched.kind, matched.id, matched.value FROM ( SELECT 'person' AS kind, p.id, p.name AS value FROM person p WHERE (p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_share ps JOIN workspace vws ON vws.id = ps.workspace_id JOIN workspace ows ON ows.id = p.workspace_id AND ows.org_id = vws.org_id WHERE ps.person_id = p.id AND ps.workspace_id = #{workspaceId})) AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.provision_ceased_at IS NULL AND p.name IS NOT NULL AND p.name != '' AND (TRIM(p.name) = TRIM(#{text}) OR (TRIM(p.name) REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+([[:space:]][A-Za-z0-9_]+)*$' AND REGEXP_LIKE( #{text}, CONCAT('(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])', TRIM(p.name), '([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)'), 'i')) OR LENGTH(TRIM(p.name)) > CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(p.name))) AND LOCATE(p.name, #{text}) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'company' AS kind, c.id, c.name AS value FROM company c WHERE (c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_share cs JOIN workspace vws ON vws.id = cs.workspace_id JOIN workspace ows ON ows.id = c.workspace_id AND ows.org_id = vws.org_id WHERE cs.company_id = c.id AND cs.workspace_id = #{workspaceId})) AND c.archived_at IS NULL AND c.name IS NOT NULL AND c.name != '' AND (TRIM(c.name) = TRIM(#{text}) OR (TRIM(c.name) REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+([[:space:]][A-Za-z0-9_]+)*$' AND REGEXP_LIKE( #{text}, CONCAT('(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])', TRIM(c.name), '([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)'), 'i')) OR LENGTH(TRIM(c.name)) > CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(c.name))) AND LOCATE(c.name, #{text}) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'deal' AS kind, d.id, d.name AS value FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.name IS NOT NULL AND d.name != '' AND (TRIM(d.name) = TRIM(#{text}) OR (TRIM(d.name) REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+([[:space:]][A-Za-z0-9_]+)*$' AND REGEXP_LIKE( #{text}, CONCAT('(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])', TRIM(d.name), '([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)'), 'i')) OR LENGTH(TRIM(d.name)) > CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(d.name))) AND LOCATE(d.name, #{text}) > 0 ) matched ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(matched.value) DESC, matched.kind, matched.id LIMIT #{limit}
